source.method: Parameters checked against game screenshots and timestamps from the table provided in the conversation. Images and the full conversation are not redistributed.
source.limitations: Rounded manual measurements; marker positions are uncertain. The 15 km point is approximate. An ideal model on level track without resistance, braking or stops; it does not establish the game’s actual physics.
